description_en: Adds a cluster to a specified security group
description_zh: 调用AddSecurityGroup将集群加入到指定的安全组
name: AddSecurityGroup

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The security group ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25556.html operation to query available security groups
parameters.help_zh:
安全组ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25556.html查询可以使用的安全组
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate a value for this parameter on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
